Jwt.//Key: Supplied at runtime via the Jwt__Key environment variable. Never commit a signing key here.
Jwt.//ExpiresInSeconds: Access token lifetime, 2 hours. The client keeps it in a script-readable cookie, so this is the window an XSS-stolen token stays usable; the 7-day refresh cookie mints replacements silently, which is what lets it be shortened again without anyone noticing.
